calculation.description: Three-session short-term reversal risk-scaled by trailing 20-session volatility, with a 50% amplification when VIX is above its trailing 252-session median. All inputs are lagged/current-date observable and signals are evaluated against subsequent returns.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (0.030273; 1075 dates), 2023-2024 (0.026305; 731 dates), and 2025-2027 (0.036800; 740 dates). Daily benchmark gates passed: absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840.
